scope: 巴林王国层面的消费者保护与广告、价格标示、规格与计量、个人数据保护、电信设备型号核准；品类聚焦小家电、家居用品与 3C 数码。不含食品/美妆/玩具等特殊品类，不含支付、物流、退换流程（Layer 3）。
review_policy: decision_level=rule_level 表示“法条原文 + 页面原文”同时成立时可给规则级判断；substantiation 表示只能判“需要证明”；human_review 表示需人工/律师复核。review_required=true 的条目必须复核后才能进入报告结论。
language_policy: 只使用巴林官方英文译本（LLOC/MOLA 发布，阿拉伯语为作准文本）或主管机关英文页面；无官方英文文本的规范仅登记为 gap，不用二手翻译。

rules.law_name: Law No. (35) of 2012 with respect to Consumer Protection 消费者保护法（2012 年第 35 号法律）
rules.requirement: 供应商或广告主须就商品的性质与特性提供准确信息，不得给消费者虚假或误导性印象，也不得造成混淆或误解；是否构成误导按整体表述与语境判断。
rules.evidence_needed: 页面快照（桌面/移动）、广告投放渠道与时间、可核事实（检测报告、认证证书、成分/参数表）、同类表述的历史版本。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反第 6 条按第 20 条处罚（罚款上限 10,000 第纳尔）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Each supplier or advertiser shall provide the consumer with accurate information about the nature and features of the product and shall avoid giving a false or misleading impression to the consumer or causing confusion or misunderstanding.
rules.notes: 上位兜底条款；不凭词表单独下结论，词表只用于定位候选表述。

rules.law_name: Law No. (35) of 2012 with respect to Consumer Protection 消费者保护法（2012 年第 35 号法律）
rules.requirement: 故意以任何发布、媒体或其他方式，用不实信息宣传商品真相、成分、规格或原产地，可处罚金/监禁；是否“故意”及信息是否不实须结合证据判断，页面文本本身不足以定性。
rules.evidence_needed: 商品真实原产地与规格资料、报关/采购单据、供应商提供的宣传素材、页面版本与修改记录。
rules.penalty_or_note: 监禁和/或罚款不超过 5,000 第纳尔（第 18 条引言）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Anyone who deliberately promotes a product by any means of publication, media or by any other method intended to inform the public by means of false information about the truth of such product, its elements, ingredients, specifications or origin.
rules.notes: 含主观要件（deliberately），只能作为“需核实”线索。

rules.law_name: Law No. (35) of 2012 with respect to Consumer Protection 消费者保护法（2012 年第 35 号法律）
rules.article: Article 5, first paragraph（罚则条文中引为 5(a)）
rules.requirement: 供应商须按部长决议的规则标明商品价格、进行促销并载明保修期；消费者有权取得载明商品种类、价格与保修期的注明日期发票。
rules.evidence_needed: 页面价格与保修期表述、结账页价格、发票样本（含日期/商品/价格/保修期）。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反第 5(a) 条按第 20 条处罚，罚款上限 10,000 第纳尔。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: A supplier shall advertise the product’s price, promote it and indicate the warranty period according to the rules and guidelines to be determined by a Minister's resolution. A consumer shall have the right to obtain a dated invoice showing the type of product, price and warranty period, if any.
rules.notes: 英文译本未保留 (a)/(b) 分段字母，条文号以第 20 条的引述为准。

rules.law_name: Law No. (35) of 2012 with respect to Consumer Protection 消费者保护法（2012 年第 35 号法律）
rules.article: Article 5, second paragraph（罚则条文中引为 5(b)）
rules.requirement: 为促销而做销售广告时，相关保修须在整个促销期有效，且价格须在促销开始前与促销期间均予标明；不得以“促销价”替代原有标价信息。
rules.evidence_needed: 促销前后的页面价格截图与时间戳、促销规则（起止时间、适用范围）、保修承诺文本。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反第 5(b) 条的具体罚则未在第 20 条列明（第 20 条只列 5(a)），适用性需律师确认。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Upon advertising for the sales of any products, the warranties concerning them shall be available during the sales period and prices shall be advertised before and during the sales period.
rules.notes: 第 20 条的罚则清单只引用 5(a)，5(b) 的处罚路径未明示，属 open question。

rules.law_name: Law No. (35) of 2012 with respect to Consumer Protection 消费者保护法（2012 年第 35 号法律）
rules.requirement: 供应商须在与消费者的往来函件、文件与文据（含电子文件与电子文据）上展示可识别其经营身份的信息。
rules.evidence_needed: 页面/邮件/电子发票上的商号、商业注册号（CR）、地址与联系方式；与 SIJILAT 登记信息比对。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反第 4 条按第 20 条处罚，罚款上限 10,000 第纳尔。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: A supplier shall display on all correspondents, documents and instruments issued thereby in its dealings or contracts with a consumer, including electronic documents and instruments, such information that can identify its business identity.
rules.notes: “经营身份”未在法条中定义到字段级，报告只可要求展示并可核。

rules.law_name: Law No. (35) of 2012 with respect to Consumer Protection 消费者保护法（2012 年第 35 号法律）
rules.requirement: 发票不得载明不退不换字样，也禁止竖立相同内容的告示牌；页面或票据出现“概不退换”类表述属可直接判定的禁止情形。
rules.evidence_needed: 发票/小票样本、页面退换政策原文与截图、门店告示照片。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反第 7 条的罚款上限 10,000 第纳尔（第 20 条）。退换流程本身属 Layer 3，不在本规则判定范围。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: The invoice shall not include wording on the non-return or replacement of the product and it shall be prohibited to erect any billboard to this effect.
rules.notes: MOIC 违规手册第 104 项以“展示不退不换声明”为独立违规，可交叉印证。

rules.law_name: Law No. (35) of 2012 with respect to Consumer Protection 消费者保护法（2012 年第 35 号法律）
rules.requirement: 供应商须遵守与商品、安全保证及适用性有关的技术要求；页面声明“安全/已认证/符合标准”时，只能要求提供符合性证据，不能据页面判断产品是否合格。
rules.evidence_needed: 符合性证书/检测报告（G-Mark、CB/IEC 报告等）、进口批次与型号清单、供应商声明。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反第 3 条按第 20 条处罚，罚款上限 10,000 第纳尔。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: A supplier shall comply with the laws, regulations and technical requirements or any other requirements concerning the product, guarantee of its safety and suitability for use according to the guidelines and conditions to be determined by a Minister's resolution.
rules.notes: 适用的具体技术法规与部长决议未在本条列明；G-Mark/GSO 低压电器法规的英文本问题见 README open questions。

rules.law_name: Law No. (35) of 2012 with respect to Consumer Protection 消费者保护法（2012 年第 35 号法律）
rules.requirement: 知悉商品缺陷且该缺陷会损害消费者健康或安全时，供应商须公告停止生产或经营、警示消费者停止使用，并向消费者保护司报告缺陷与已采取措施。
rules.evidence_needed: 缺陷与事故记录、召回/警示公告渠道与时间、向主管机关的报送记录。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反第 7 条的罚款上限 10,000 第纳尔（第 20 条）；是否“知悉”与缺陷因果需事实调查。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Upon learning about the existence of a defect in the product and where such defect results in damage to the consumer’s health or safety, the supplier shall announce his/its cessation to produce it or dealing therewith and shall warn the consumer against using the product and shall inform the concerned Directorate of such defect and its likely harms and the actions taken in this matter.
rules.notes: 页面通常不可观察，只在出现召回/警示信息时作为核对点。

rules.law_name: Law No. (35) of 2012 with respect to Consumer Protection 消费者保护法（2012 年第 35 号法律）
rules.requirement: 违反第 3、4、5(a)、6、7、8、9 条的任一规定，罚款上限 10,000 第纳尔；本条目用于在报告中说明罚则上限，不作违规定性。
rules.evidence_needed: 违规事实对应的具体条文、主管机关的处理记录（如有）。
rules.penalty_or_note: 罚款上限 10,000 第纳尔；不排除刑法或其他法律更重处罚。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Without prejudice to a harsher penalty provided for in the Penal Code or in any other law, a fine not exceeding ten thousand Dinars shall be inflicted upon anyone who violates any of the provisions of Articles (3), (4), (5)(a), (6), (7), (8) and (9).
rules.notes: 罚则条目仅引用上限，不写“必然处罚”。

rules.law_name: Law No. (35) of 2012 with respect to Consumer Protection 消费者保护法（2012 年第 35 号法律）
rules.requirement: 定罪判决可附加没收或销毁涉案商品及作案工具并负担费用；3 年内重犯的，法院按最高刑度判处并可暂停营业不超过 3 个月或注销商业登记。
rules.evidence_needed: 既往处罚记录、判决书（如有）。
rules.penalty_or_note: 没收/销毁 + 公开判决 + 暂停营业或注销登记；属加重情形，不作一般性推断。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: In case of recurrence within 3 years from the date of handing down the final conviction judgement, the Court shall pass a judgement for inflicting the maximum prescribed penalty and suspension of the business for a period not exceeding 3 months or finally striking off the registration in the Commerce Registry.

rules.law_name: Legislative Decree No. (14) of 1973 regarding the Regulation of Advertisement 广告管理法令（1973 年第 14 号）
rules.requirement: 广告须使用阿拉伯语；可在阿拉伯语之外附加外语；广告上须以书面载明许可证号。纯英文页面、无阿拉伯语版本、无许可证号属可直接比对的缺失项。
rules.evidence_needed: 页面语言版本（阿拉伯语/英语）、许可证号展示位置、广告投放主体与媒体。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反广告法条件可按第 16 条处以不超过 100 第纳尔的罚款（持续违规按日 1 第纳尔）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Advertisements shall be in the Arabic language, and it is permissible to include a foreign language in addition to Arabic, and the license number shall be affixed to the advertisement in writing.
rules.notes: 1973 年法令是否覆盖电商产品页/线上广告无官方英文说明，需律师确认；本条目在报告中只能写“需核对阿拉伯语与许可证号”。

rules.law_name: Legislative Decree No. (14) of 1973 regarding the Regulation of Advertisement 广告管理法令（1973 年第 14 号）
rules.requirement: 未经市政与农业主管部门许可，不得直接开展广告活动；取得许可不免除许可内容本身的责任。
rules.evidence_needed: 广告许可证、许可范围与有效期、投放媒体清单。
rules.penalty_or_note: 第 16 条：罚款不超过 100 第纳尔；持续违规每日 1 第纳尔。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Advertisements cannot be conducted directly without obtaining a license from the Ministry of Municipalities and Agriculture. The executive decisions issued by the Ministry of Municipalities and Agriculture clarify the procedures for submitting advertising license applications, their conditions, examination, decision-making, and fees for granting and renewing them. Granting the license does not entail any responsibility for what it allows.
rules.notes: 主管机关在现行政府架构中已变更（市政与农业部分拆），实际受理机关需核实。

rules.law_name: Legislative Decree No. (14) of 1973 regarding the Regulation of Advertisement 广告管理法令（1973 年第 14 号）
rules.requirement: 广告内容本身须先取得主管机关的事前批准。
rules.evidence_needed: 内容审批文件、审批机关与日期、送审文案与实际投放文案的一致性。
rules.penalty_or_note: 第 16 条罚款路径同上。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Prior approval must be obtained from the competent authority referred to in the previous article regarding the subject of the advertisement itself.
rules.notes: 与第 3 条许可的关系（许可 vs 内容审批）在英文译本中未细化，需核阿拉伯语原文与实施决定。

rules.law_name: Legislative Decree No. (14) of 1973 regarding the Regulation of Advertisement 广告管理法令（1973 年第 14 号）
rules.requirement: 广告须与所在区域协调并不得与交通、公共安全、公共道德或宗教信仰相冲突；是否触碰宗教/道德敏感属语境判断。
rules.evidence_needed: 页面图像与文案、投放地区、当地文化/宗教敏感点清单、投诉记录。
rules.penalty_or_note: 第 16 条罚款路径；主管机关亦可依第 10 条责令移除。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Advertisements shall be in harmony and serve the beautification of the area in which they will be placed, and they must not conflict with traffic, public security, public morals, or religious beliefs.
rules.notes: 该条原为户外广告条款，线上适用性需人工判断。

rules.law_name: Legislative Decree No. (14) of 1973 regarding the Regulation of Advertisement 广告管理法令（1973 年第 14 号）
rules.requirement: 为自己利益发起或允许发布违反法令及实施决定的广告，罚款不超过 100 第纳尔；判决后仍持续违规的，按日 1 第纳尔计罚。
rules.evidence_needed: 违规广告的投放主体与时间、主管机关通知/判决。
rules.penalty_or_note: 罚款上限 100 第纳尔；持续违规每日 1 第纳尔。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Whoever initiates or allows the publication of any advertisement for their own benefit, contrary to the conditions and provisions stipulated in this Law and its implementing decisions, shall be punished with a fine not exceeding one hundred dinars. In the event of their continued violation after the issuance of a judgement against them, they shall be punished with a fine of one dinar for each day the advertisement remains in non-compliance.
rules.notes: 罚则金额为 1973 年水平，实务中可能与其他法律并行适用。

rules.law_name: Legislative Decree No. (18) of 1975 regarding Price Determination and Monitoring 价格确定与监管法令（1975 年第 18 号）
rules.requirement: 零售商须展示其所售定价或限利商品的价格；部长决定可要求对非定价商品同样标价，标价须以阿拉伯语写在牌卡上并置于显眼可见位置。
rules.evidence_needed: 页面/货架标价截图、标价语言（阿拉伯语）、牌卡位置与可见性、商品是否属定价/限利清单。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反第 14 条适用第 21 条第（一）项“违反本法其他条款”：监禁不超过 3 个月和/或罚款不超过 250 第纳尔。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Retailers must display the prices of all priced or profit-regulated goods they offer for sale. By ministerial decision, the Minister of Commerce, Agriculture, and Economy may also require retailers to announce the prices of unpriced or non-profit-regulated goods. Such announcements must be made on a card written in Arabic and prominently displayed in a visible location.
rules.notes: 线上标价是否等同“牌卡”需人工判断；第 21 条罚则的具体适用需核对。

rules.law_name: Legislative Decree No. (18) of 1975 regarding Price Determination and Monitoring 价格确定与监管法令（1975 年第 18 号）
rules.requirement: 拒绝出售非定价商品，或就商品向买方索取高于其标示价格的价格，可处监禁不超过 3 个月和/或罚款不超过 250 第纳尔。
rules.evidence_needed: 标价截图（商品页/货架）、结账页或收银小票实付价格、时间戳。
rules.penalty_or_note: 监禁不超过 3 个月和/或罚款不超过 250 第纳尔。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Imprisonment for a term not exceeding three months and a fine not exceeding two hundred and fifty dinars, or with one of these penalties, shall be imposed on anyone who refuses to sell an unpriced or non-profit-limited good or who demands from a buyer a price exceeding the advertised price of the good.
rules.notes: 页面标价与结账价不一致是可直接比对的证据链。

rules.law_name: Ministerial Order No. (1) of 2007 regarding retail prices（原文未取得）；要求见 MOIC 消费者保护 FAQ
rules.article: FAQ 条目（引 Ministerial Order No. (1) of 2007）
rules.requirement: 商店不得以高于公布价格的价格向消费者出售商品；页面标价高于结账价即属可核事实，主管机关为消费者保护司。
rules.evidence_needed: 商品页/货架标价、结账页价格、付款凭证；如为线上下单，需订单确认页与支付页截图。
rules.penalty_or_note: FAQ 未载罚则；2007 年第 1 号部长令的官方英文本未取得，罚则与条文号待补（见 SOURCES.md 未取得来源）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: shop do not have the right to sell any commodity or product to consumer for a price higher than the announced price as this action is a violation to the ministerial order no. (1) year 2007 in regards of retail price
rules.notes: source 为机关英文 FAQ，不是法条原文；effective_date 取部长令年份的保守值，需以原文核对。

rules.law_name: Legislative Decree No. (16) of 1985 regarding Specifications and Measures 规格与计量法令（1985 年第 16 号）
rules.requirement: 未经规格与计量主管机关书面许可，不得使用任何暗示“国家规格”“巴林标准规格”“巴林规格”或类似表述的标记、图形、符号或标志（含缩写，不限语言）。
rules.evidence_needed: 页面使用的标志/措辞截图、授权文件（如有）、与 BSMD 的往来记录。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反法令可按第 18 条处监禁不超过 6 个月和/或罚款不超过 500 第纳尔。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Without written permission from the Specifications and Measures Authority, it is not permissible to use any mark, shape, symbol, or sign that implies "national standard specifications," "Bahraini standard specifications," "Bahraini specifications," or similar phrases or any abbreviation thereof, whether in Arabic or any other language.
rules.notes: 只约束“巴林标准”类标志，不涵盖 ISO/CE 等第三方认证表述。

rules.law_name: Legislative Decree No. (16) of 1985 regarding Specifications and Measures 规格与计量法令（1985 年第 16 号）
rules.requirement: 国家规格是进出口业务的基础；确有需要时可由工商部长决定给予豁免。商品是否落入强制规格、是否取得豁免，只能要求提供文件核实。
rules.evidence_needed: 适用的巴林/GSO 标准编号、符合性证书或豁免决定、进口批次记录。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反法令可按第 18 条处罚；豁免须有部长决定。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: National standard specifications are considered the basis for import and export operations, and in cases of necessity, exemptions from these specifications, or some of them, may be granted by the decision of the Minister of Commerce and Agriculture.
rules.notes: 具体强制标准清单未随法令公布，需向 BSMD 核对。

rules.law_name: Legislative Decree No. (16) of 1985 regarding Specifications and Measures 规格与计量法令（1985 年第 16 号）
rules.requirement: 主管机关负责质量管制并确保进口商品符合国家规格以及经批准的海湾合作委员会规格组织（GSO）标准；进口商品须能提供符合性证据。
rules.evidence_needed: GSO/巴林标准编号与版本、检测报告、符合性声明（DoC）、G-Mark 证书（如适用）。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反法令可按第 18 条处罚。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Provisions for quality control and ensuring the conformity of imported goods to national standard specifications and standards issued by the Gulf Cooperation Council Specifications and Measures Authority or the Arab Organization for Specifications and Measures, as approved.
rules.notes: GSO 低压电器技术法规的英文本为“非官方译本”，见 README open questions。

rules.law_name: Legislative Decree No. (16) of 1985 regarding Specifications and Measures 规格与计量法令（1985 年第 16 号）
rules.requirement: 违反本法令者，处监禁不超过 6 个月或罚款不超过 500 第纳尔，或两者之一；不排除其他法律更重处罚。
rules.evidence_needed: 违规事实与对应条文、主管机关处理记录。
rules.penalty_or_note: 监禁不超过 6 个月和/或罚款不超过 500 第纳尔。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Without prejudice to any more severe penalties stipulated by any other law, whoever violates the provisions of this Law shall be punished with imprisonment for a period not exceeding six months or a fine not exceeding five hundred Bahraini dinars, or either of these two penalties.

rules.law_name: Legislative Decree No. (6) of 1977 regarding Weights, Measures and Quantities 度量衡法令（1977 年第 6 号）
rules.requirement: 度量衡与数量实行十进公制，以法定单位（米、千克、升、平方米）及其倍数/分数表示；页面规格若只用英制单位，属可核对的单位缺失项。
rules.evidence_needed: 页面规格与包装标示的单位、换算表、是否同时标注公制。
rules.penalty_or_note: 第 9 条对违反第 6 条等情形设罚则；第 1 条本身的处罚路径需核对第 9 条适用范围。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: The decimal metric system shall be implemented for weights, measures, and quantities in accordance with the standard units specified in the following article, including their multiples and decimal fractions.
rules.notes: 公制强制是否延伸到营销文案中的英制换算未明示；第 10 条把实施交由部长决定分阶段推行。

rules.law_name: Law No. (30) of 2018 with respect to Personal Data Protection 个人数据保护法（2018 年第 30 号）
rules.requirement: 除为履行合同、法定义务、保护重大利益、追求正当利益等必要情形外，处理个人数据须取得数据主体同意；页面收集邮箱/手机号时只能核查其同意基础，不能仅凭表单判断。
rules.evidence_needed: 同意记录（勾选、时间戳、来源页）、隐私政策版本、处理目的说明、拒绝同意的后果说明。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反第 5 条等情形按第 58 条处罚：监禁不超过 1 年和/或罚款 1,000–20,000 第纳尔（第 58 条未单列第 4 条）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Processing Personal data is prohibited without the data subject’s consent, unless the processing is necessary for:
rules.notes: 第 4 条列举的必要情形以列表呈现，引文只取引言句。

rules.law_name: Law No. (30) of 2018 with respect to Personal Data Protection 个人数据保护法（2018 年第 30 号）
rules.requirement: 直接从数据主体取得数据时，控制者须在登记数据时告知：控制者全名/行业/地址、处理目的，以及为公平处理所必需的其他信息（接收方类别、回答是否强制及后果、查阅与更正权、是否用于直接营销）。
rules.evidence_needed: 收集页的告知文本/隐私政策、告知时点（收集前/收集时）、字段与目的对应表。
rules.penalty_or_note: 第 17 条未列入第 58 条罚则清单，处罚路径待核。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: In situations where data is directly obtained from the data subject, the data controller shall brief the data subject , upon registration of such data, on the following:
rules.notes: 告知项以分项列出；报告按项核对是否缺失，逐项引用 (a)-(c)。

rules.law_name: Law No. (30) of 2018 with respect to Personal Data Protection 个人数据保护法（2018 年第 30 号）
rules.requirement: 除数据主体同意、履行合同必要、法定义务等例外，或经主管机关认定接收国/地区具备充分保护（或逐案授权）外，禁止将个人数据转移到巴林境外。
rules.evidence_needed: 数据流向与服务器所在地、跨境传输依据（同意/合同必要/充分性认定/授权）、与境外处理者的合同条款。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反第 12/13 条按第 58 条处罚：监禁不超过 1 年和/或罚款 1,000–20,000 第纳尔。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: The Data Controller is prohibited from transferring personal data outside the Kingdom, except for the following cases:
rules.notes: 充分性名单由主管机关编制并公布，本版未取得清单。

rules.law_name: Law No. (30) of 2018 with respect to Personal Data Protection 个人数据保护法（2018 年第 30 号）
rules.requirement: 预期将个人数据用于直接营销时，控制者须告知数据主体可免费向其提出反对；反对后须在 10 个工作日内停止或不予开始该营销处理。
rules.evidence_needed: 营销订阅页的反对权告知、退订入口、退订请求处理记录与时限。
rules.penalty_or_note: 第 19 条未列入第 58 条罚则清单；第 20 条设反对权与 10 个工作日时限。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Where a Data Controller anticipates that personal data which is kept by him, including personal data that is required by law to be made available to the public, may be processed for the purposes of direct marketing, the data controller shall inform the data subject of the latter’s right to submit, free of charge, his objection to the Data Controller with respect to such processing,

rules.law_name: Law No. (30) of 2018 with respect to Personal Data Protection 个人数据保护法（2018 年第 30 号）
rules.requirement: 数据控制者对全部或部分自动化的处理作业，须事先向主管机关（个人数据保护局）通报；未通报即处理属第 58 条明列的违规情形。
rules.evidence_needed: 向主管机关的通报回执/登记记录、处理目的与数据类别说明、变更通报记录。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反第 14(1) 条按第 58 条处罚：监禁不超过 1 年和/或罚款 1,000–20,000 第纳尔。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: The Data Controller shall give prior notice to the Authority of any wholly or partially automated processing operation, or set of such operations, intended to serve a single purpose or several related purposes.
rules.notes: 通报豁免情形（如任命数据保护监护人）见第 14 条第 2 款。

rules.law_name: Law No. (30) of 2018 with respect to Personal Data Protection 个人数据保护法（2018 年第 30 号）
rules.requirement: 违反第 5 条（敏感数据）、第 12/13 条（跨境传输）、第 14(1)/14(6) 条（通报）、第 15 条（事前授权）等情形，处监禁不超过 1 年和/或罚款 1,000–20,000 第纳尔。
rules.evidence_needed: 对应违规事实与条文、主管机关处理记录。
rules.penalty_or_note: 监禁不超过 1 年和/或罚款 1,000–20,000 第纳尔；法人按第 59 条罚金上限加倍。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: A person shall be liable to imprisonment for a term not exceeding one year, and / or a fine not less than BD 1000/- and not exceeding BD 20,000/- in the following circumstance:
rules.notes: 罚则为区间（下限+上限），与 CP Law 的“上限”写法不同，报告中不得写成固定金额。

rules.law_name: TRA — Type Approval（无线电与电信终端设备注册制度，依 2003 年电信法）
rules.article: TRA Type Approval FAQ — Introduction of Type Approval
rules.requirement: 接入公共电信网络或为有意发射无线电波的设备（RTTE），须在巴林使用、销售或分销前完成 TRA 型号核准（Type Approval）注册；注册以符合性声明与测试报告为基础。
rules.evidence_needed: TRA 型号核准/注册记录、符合性声明与测试报告、设备型号与频段清单。
rules.penalty_or_note: TRA 指南未在本页列明罚则；电信法下的处罚路径待补（见 SOURCES.md）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Such equipment must be registered with the TRA before it can be used, sold or distributed in the Kingdom.
rules.notes: guideline 类条目，effective_date 取抓取日；2003 年电信法下的具体条款未逐条引用。适用于含蓝牙/Wi-Fi 的小家电与 3C 数码，纯有线电器不适用。

rules.law_name: TRA — Type Approval（无线电与电信终端设备注册制度，依 2003 年电信法）
rules.article: TRA Type Approval FAQ — Who can apply for type approval?
rules.requirement: 型号核准申请人必须是巴林本地注册的商业公司；境外制造商不能自行申请，须通过本地持证/注册主体办理。
rules.evidence_needed: 申请主体的巴林商业注册（CR）信息、授权代理/进口商协议、TRA 注册持有人。
rules.penalty_or_note: 同上，罚则路径待补。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: All Type approval applicants must be local commercially registered companies.
rules.notes: guideline 类条目，effective_date 取抓取日。这是市场准入的结构性门槛，直接影响中国中小企业的落地路径。
